hotels.summary: All three incumbents re-priced live on Booking.com (signed out, INR, 3 adults, exact nights) on 20 Aug 2026. All three are AVAILABLE, but two have only 1 room left. Bhūma got CHEAPER (Rs 5,685, not Rs 6,920 — the earlier quote was the larger Family Double Room; a smaller 23 m² Family Room with 1 full + 1 king + 1 sofa bed is open at Rs 5,685 = Rs 1,895 pp, but it is non-refundable and only 1 left). Blue Lagoon Neil is UNCHANGED at Rs 3,968 (Rs 1,323 pp) with breakfast and free cancellation to 17 Sep — the best-value confirmed stay of the trip. Hotel Atlanta Port Blair is UNCHANGED at Rs 8,845 for 2 nights (Rs 1,474 pp/night), 1 room left, but it is the weakest pick: 7.9 review score (below the 8.0 bar), breakfast NOT included (Rs 250 extra), and the Family Room has no sea view despite the hotel name. Pibo Homestay beats it on every axis — Rs 5,250 for the same 2 nights (Rs 875 pp/night), 9.3/10 from 138 reviews, breakfast included, free cancellation to 24 Sep — so Port Blair is where the real saving is (Rs 3,595 cheaper). Every option below genuinely accommodates 3 in one room unless flagged. Whole-trip total on the current incumbents = Rs 18,498 (Rs 1,541 pp/night average) vs Rs 14,903 (Rs 1,242 pp/night) if you swap Port Blair to Pibo. Both are comfortably under the Rs 2,000 pp target.

recommendation: HAVELOCK (23–24 Sep): Keep Bhūma, but book the Rs 5,685 Family Room, not the Rs 6,920 room you were quoted — same property, same 9.5 score, 50 m from Govind Nagar Beach, breakfast included, and it lands at Rs 1,895 pp, under your Rs 2,000 target. Two catches: only 1 left and it is non-refundable, so decide today. If it goes or you want a refundable booking, Havelock Farms Resort's King Suite (1 king + 1 sofa bed, 37 m², 5 left, Rs 6,635 Genius / ~Rs 7,600 public, breakfast, also on Govind Nagar) is the fallback — but its free-cancellation window closes 24 August.

NEIL (24–25 Sep): Keep Blue Lagoon Resort, unchanged at Rs 3,968 — Rs 1,323 pp, a third under target. It is the only property on Neil that combines an 8.0+ score (8.6 from 255 reviews) with breakfast AND free cancellation to 17 Sep, at a public non-Genius rate, with 4 rooms left. The next 8.0+ option on the island jumps to Rs 11,682. Just ring the property to confirm the third bed, since Booking lists only 1 king for max 3.

PORT BLAIR (25–27 Sep): Switch away from Hotel Atlanta. It re-prices at the same Rs 8,845 but only has 1 room left, scores 7.9 (below your bar), charges Rs 250 extra for breakfast, and has no sea view despite the name. Take Pibo Homestay instead: Rs 5,250 for both nights (Rs 875 pp/night), 9.3 from 138 reviews, 1 full + 1 king bed, breakfast included, free cancellation right up to 24 Sep — Rs 3,595 saved. It also has only 1 room left, so book it now. If you specifically want a real sea view, The Seaview Residency's Super Deluxe (Rs 9,450, genuine sea view, beachfront, breakfast, free cancel) is the only verified one — also 1 left.
warnings: SCARCITY: three of the best picks show 'We have 1 left' right now — Bhūma Family Room (Havelock), Pibo Homestay Family Room (Port Blair), and The Seaview Residency Super Deluxe with Sea view. Hotel Atlanta's Family Room is also down to 1. These can vanish within hours on 2026 Andaman dates; if you want any of them, book that one first.

GENIUS / MEMBERS-ONLY PRICES (I was signed out throughout, so these were shown as locked): Havelock Farms Resort King Suite Rs 6,635 and Deluxe Double (king) Rs 5,222 are Genius rates — public equivalents are roughly Rs 7,600 and Rs 5,912. Blue Bird Resort Rs 5,511 is Genius; public is Rs 6,804. Senses Havelock Rs 7,347 is Genius; public is Rs 13,606 — an unusually large gap, treat with suspicion. Everything else quoted here (Bhūma, Blue Lagoon, Hotel Atlanta, Pibo, Royal Seaview, The Seaview Residency, Ananya, Le Luminous) is a PUBLIC price needing no account.

HAVELOCK FARMS FREE-CANCELLATION CLIFF: every Havelock Farms rate says 'Free cancellation before August 24, 2026' — that is four days from today. Book after 24 August and it is effectively non-refundable. Bhūma's cheapest rates are non-refundable from the start.

BEDS vs OCCUPANCY — rooms Booking calls 'Max people: 3' that list fewer than 3 beds, meaning someone gets a rollaway or mattress: Blue Lagoon Neil King Room (1 king), Havelock Farms Deluxe Double (1 queen or 1 king), The Seaview Residency Super Deluxe (1 queen) and Deluxe Room (1 full). Given the party is a man, his brother and his younger sister, confirm the extra bed by phone before arrival. Rooms with genuinely separate beds for three: Bhūma Family Room and Family Double Room, Havelock Farms King Suite, Hotel Atlanta Family Room (2 full beds), Pibo Family Room (1 full + 1 king), Royal Seaview Deluxe Family Room (2 queen beds), Ananya Triple Room.

FORCED TWO-ROOM BOOKINGS (group gets split): Emerald Gecko, The Forest Elephant, Wild Orchid, Senses Havelock, Yerrata (Havelock); Jungle Beach Resort, Blue Bird Residency, Blue Sea Beach Bungalows (Neil); Aqua Horizon, Le Luminous, Continental Homestay, Haven Garden, Urbban Castle, AMINA LODGE (Port Blair). Prices shown for these cover both rooms.

NOT SUITABLE, DESPITE APPEARING IN BAND: Hotel Rajlaxmi on Neil at Rs 2,625 is a MIXED DORMITORY (shared dorm room) — wrong for a family group. Rajeswari AC Dormitory in Port Blair at Rs 3,774 is 3 beds in an 8-bed dorm. Emerald Gecko in Havelock has a SHARED toilet, not private.

THIN REVIEW COUNTS — treat these scores cautiously: Natures Nook Andaman 9.7 from just 3 reviews, SEA SUN PARADISE 10.0 from 1 review, Hotel Akshaya 9.0 from 1 review, Jungle Beach Resort 8.4 from 11 reviews, Horizon View 9.0 from 2 reviews. I have kept these out of the recommendations.

BOOKING'S 'km from downtown' IS UNRELIABLE ON HAVELOCK: nearly every island property reads 6–9 km because the centroid sits away from the settlements. Bhūma is genuinely 50 m from Govind Nagar Beach and Havelock Farms is on Govind Nagar SH5, despite reading 7 km and 7.9 km. Use the property descriptions, not that number.

BHŪMA IS CASH-ONLY: the property accepts cash payments only, requires payment before arrival by bank transfer, and collects a Rs 5,000 refundable cash damage deposit on check-in. Check-in window is a narrow 11:30–19:00 and check-out is 09:00–09:30 — tight against a Neil ferry the next morning.
HOTEL ATLANTA'S NAME OVERSELLS IT: the 'Seaview Hotel' Family Room lists no sea view among its facilities. If sea view is what you were paying for there, you are not getting it.

I read all prices signed out, in INR, with taxes and fees included, on 20 August 2026. Andaman prices for late-September dates move daily and these are not held — re-check before booking. I did not log in, book, or enter any personal or payment details.

scuba.summary:
DECISION-CRITICAL FINDING: Neil Island in the afternoon does not work. Turquoise Dream (Neil Kendra / Bharatpur, the main Neil dive centre) publishes a live booking calendar — for Thu 24 Sep 2026 the ONLY slots offered are 05:30 AM, 07:30 AM and 10:00 AM. Every Turquoise Dream program (DSD Basic, DSD Premium, Fun Dive) shows the same three morning slots; there is no afternoon slot at all. Their DSD needs 2.5-3 h. A 15:45 ferry arrival cannot make a Neil dive on Thursday. Havelock morning at Govind Nagar is the workable plan.

HAVELOCK / GOVIND NAGAR (option A):
- Dive Andaman (Beach No. 2, Govind Nagar) — the previously-seen figures need correcting. On the operator's own site there is NO Rs 3,500 shore "Try Dive" (the Rs 3,500 items are snorkelling). The Rs 5,500 figure is the struck-through LIST price of "Shore Dive (Discover Scuba Dive, PADI Program) in Havelock Island", which now sells at Rs 4,500. That is 45 min underwater, 2.0 h total, 1:1 instructor, Nemo Reef, 12 m, non-swimmers OK, free photo/video, free pickup within 3 km. Their page states the diving window as 05:00 am - 2:30 pm, so 2:30 pm is the latest start. GST is NOT mentioned anywhere on the page or in the booking widget — the price displays as a flat Rs 4,500 with no tax line even after selecting 3 persons. Treat GST as unconfirmed, not as "included".
- Barefoot Scuba (Beach No. 3, Govind Nagar, ~50 m from Beach 3) is the clearest-priced comparison: PADI DSD single boat dive Rs 6,500, explicitly "18% GST additional" (= Rs 7,670), 3-4 h total with 35 min dive time at max 12 m, 1:1 ratio, complimentary photo/video, shore or boat by choice. Price list is headed 2026-27 and valid till 31 July 2027.
- DiveIndia (Beach No. 5, White Sand Beach Resort, Govind Nagar) has NO one-day try dive any more. Their shortest beginner program is "Intro to Scuba", 2 DAYS / 2 dives, Rs 14,000 per person all-inclusive with taxes included. That cannot fit a single Thursday.

NEIL / BHARATPUR (option B) — operators that genuinely run FROM Neil:
- Turquoise Dream Dive Center, Neil Kendra (jetty/Bharatpur area): SDI Scuba Discovery, DSD Basic Rs 4,500 exclusive of tax (2.5 h, 25 min underwater) or DSD Premium Rs 6,500 exclusive of tax (3 h, 45 min underwater), 12 m, age 10+, skill level stated as "non swimmer". Bookable on 24 Sep 2026 — but morning only.
- Dive Tribe, Bharatpur Beach: SSI "Try Scuba" Rs 4,500 *exclusive of 18% GST (= Rs 5,310), 3-6 hours, age 8+ on the course page. Note an internal contradiction: the course page says max depth 5 metres and "fit to swim", while their FAQ says Try Scuba goes "up to 12 metres", min age 10, and non-swimmers are fine one-on-one. Confirm which before paying.
- DiveIndia also has a real Neil centre ("DIVEResort, Bharatpur Beach, 50 Meters from Jetty, Neil Kendra") but only the same 2-day Rs 14,000 Intro to Scuba.
- Dive Andaman lists a "Boat Dive (DSD)" at Rs 7,500 under Neil Island, but the page body is entirely Havelock: dive sites Red Pillar / Tribe Gate, "Free pickup drop up to 3 km from Havelock Island Beach Resort", and the heading "How Will Boat Dive in Havelock Island Begin". Do not treat this as a genuine Neil-departure price.

FLYING: Dive Andaman's shore DSD page says "wait at least 12 hours before flying after scuba diving"; their boat DSD page says "Avoid flights for 12-18 hours after diving". Their "New Diving Rules in Andaman & Nicobar Islands 2026" page is stricter and states diving is prohibited "Within 24 hours before flying in a pressurised aircraft". A Thursday dive against a Sunday 10:35 flight leaves roughly 70 hours — clear under every one of these rules.

LATE SEPTEMBER / MONSOON: operators disagree. Dive Andaman's boat DSD page says "June to September is monsoon - turbid water, high waves, and most dive shops are shut", while their shore DSD page says the off-season is "hit or miss" but "they'll still run the dives". Dive Tribe says "Monsoon months (June-September) may have limited diving depending on weather conditions". DiveIndia says diving is "All year round, dictated only by the Ocean's moods". Turquoise Dream's booking engine actively offers 24 Sep 2026 slots. Under the 2026 rules a dive is only permitted when wave height is below 0.5 m and visibility exceeds 4 m, so a same-week weather call is realistic.

RECOMMENDATION FOR 3 ADULTS: Thursday morning at Govind Nagar. Dive Andaman's Shore DSD at Rs 4,500 x 3 = Rs 13,500 (plus GST if it turns out to be extra — ask), 2 hours, 45 min underwater, and they sleep 50 m away. Barefoot Scuba at Rs 6,500 + 18% = Rs 7,670 x 3 = Rs 23,010 is the transparent-pricing alternative on Beach No. 3 with a longer 3-4 h program. Book 2-3 days ahead by phone/WhatsApp and reconfirm the evening before for weather.

options.program: Shore Dive (Discover Scuba Dive, PADI Program) in Havelock Island
options.base_location: Beach No. 2, Govind Nagar, Havelock (Swaraj Dweep) 744211 - free pickup/drop up to 3 km from Havelock Island Beach Resort
options.duration: Total activity 2.0 hours; 45 minutes underwater. Dry-land briefing 15-20 min, then waist-deep practice, then reef tour. Site Nemo Reef, stated max depth 12 m but the page says most of the dive stays at 5-6 m. 1:1 instructor-to-participant ratio. Complimentary photography and videography.
options.session_times: Page states 'The best time for scuba diving:- 05:00 am - 2:30 pm', so the LATEST start offered is about 2:30 pm. The page also advises 6-10 am as the ideal calm-sea window. The booking widget takes a date and number of people only - no time-slot picker.
options.gst_note: NOT STATED. The page shows a flat Rs 4500 (struck-through list price Rs 5500) with no tax line, and the price did not change or add GST when 3 persons were selected in the booking widget. The previously-seen 'Rs 5,500 + 18% GST' does not match the site: Rs 5,500 is the old list price, now discounted to Rs 4,500, and GST is nowhere mentioned. Confirm by phone (+91 72900 55523).
options.september_operating: Mixed signals from the same operator. Shore DSD page: outside Nov-Apr it is 'hit or miss... You can still go, and they'll still run the dives, but it's not as nice.' Their boat DSD page says 'June to September is monsoon - turbid water, high waves, and most dive shops are shut.' Their date picker accepts 24 Sep 2026.
options.booking_lead: Page advises calling 'a day before or two' (their peak-season advice is Dec-Mar). Cancellation policy: 30+ days 100% refund, 7-29 days 50% refund, less than 7 days no refund, 5% admin charge on refunds.
options.beginner_friendly: Yes - 'Swimming is not required (as it's a beginners Dive)'. Age 12 and above. Anyone 50+ must carry a doctor's medical fitness certificate. Health form required; asthma/heart trouble/recent surgery needs a doctor's note.

options.program: PADI Discover Scuba Diving (DSD) - single boat dive
options.base_location: Beach No. 3, Govind Nagar, Swaraj Dweep (Havelock) 744211 - dive centre is about 50 metres from Beach No. 3
options.duration: 3-4 hours total. Briefing, then a shallow-water practice session, then the reef tour. Dive time 35 minutes at a maximum of 12 m / 40 ft. 1:1 student-instructor ratio. Shore or boat entry 'as per your choice'. Underwater photography/videography is complimentary for DSD.
options.session_times: Not published on the site. Must be confirmed by phone/email (+91 95660 88560 / +91 94742 63120, dive@barefootindia.com).
options.gst_note: GST IS EXTRA AND EXPLICIT. The 2026-27 Activity Price List footer reads 'Prices valid till 31 July 2027 | 18% GST additional'. Rs 6,500 + 18% = Rs 7,670 per person. Add-ons on the same list: extra dive same day (no photo/video) Rs 3,500; 2 dives at Turtle Beach & Aquarium Rs 11,500 (minimum 2 people).
options.september_operating: Not stated on the site. The price list is headed '2026-27' and valid till 31 July 2027, implying year-round operation, but confirm directly for late September.
options.booking_lead: Not stated. Contact directly; they run a 'Manage Booking' portal and an online booking engine.
options.beginner_friendly: Yes - non-swimmers explicitly catered for: '1:1 instructor-student ratio and the instructor will do all the swimming for you'. Minimum age 10 (Bubblemaker from 8, Rs 7,000). No upper age limit but people over 50 need a written medical certificate, described as an Andaman regulation. PADI Medical Form required.

options.base_location: Beach No. 5, White Sand Beach Resort, Govind Nagar, Swaraj Dweep (Havelock)
options.duration: 2 DAYS - does not fit a single Thursday. Day 0 orientation, Day 1 confined-water skills plus snorkelling and possibly a short supervised shore dive, Day 2 two boat dives. 2 dives total, max depth 12 m.

warnings: DECISIVE: A Thursday-afternoon Neil dive is not bookable. Turquoise Dream's live booking calendar for Thu 24 Sep 2026 offers ONLY 05:30 AM, 07:30 AM and 10:00 AM - for every program including Fun Dive. Latest start 10:00 AM against a 15:45 ferry arrival. Dive Tribe publishes no times but its Try Scuba is a 3-6 hour program and the 2026 rules require daylight diving. Plan the dive for Thursday MORNING at Govind Nagar, Havelock.

The figures in the brief do not match Dive Andaman's own site. There is NO Rs 3,500 shore 'Try Dive' - every Rs 3,500 item in their catalogue is snorkelling. The Rs 5,500 is the struck-through LIST price of the Shore DSD, which now sells at Rs 4,500. And '+18% GST' appears nowhere on Dive Andaman's site.

Dive Andaman does not state GST anywhere - not on the product pages, not in the booking widget (the price stayed a flat Rs 4,500 with no tax line even after selecting 3 persons), and not in the cancellation policy. Whether Rs 4,500 is inclusive or exclusive is genuinely unknown. Ask on +91 72900 55523 before assuming. By contrast Barefoot Scuba (18% GST additional), Turquoise Dream (Exclusive of Tax) and Dive Tribe (*exclusive of 18% GST) all say so plainly, and DiveIndia states taxes are included.

Dive Andaman lists a 'Boat Dive (DSD)' at Rs 7,500 under its Neil Island destination page, but the page content is entirely Havelock - dive sites Red Pillar and Tribe Gate, pickup from Havelock Island Beach Resort, and a heading reading 'How Will Boat Dive in Havelock Island Begin'. This is exactly the Havelock-price-pasted-onto-Neil trap. Dive Andaman is a Havelock-based centre (Beach No. 2, Govind Nagar); treat it as a Havelock operator only.

Dive Tribe's own pages contradict each other on the two things that matter most to a first-timer. Course page: max depth 5 metres, minimum age 8, prerequisite 'Fit to swim'. FAQ page: Try Scuba goes 'up to 12 metres', minimum age 10, and swimming is explicitly not required. As written, the course page describes a confined-water session rather than a reef dive. Get this in writing before booking.

Late September is monsoon and the operators openly disagree. Dive Andaman's boat DSD page says 'June to September is monsoon - turbid water, high waves, and most dive shops are shut'; Dive Tribe says monsoon months 'may have limited diving depending on weather conditions'; DiveIndia says diving runs all year. Turquoise Dream's booking engine does offer 24 Sep 2026. Under the 2026 Andaman rules a dive is only permitted when wave height is below 0.5 m and underwater visibility exceeds 4 m, so a last-minute cancellation is a real risk. Keep a flexible plan and reconfirm the evening before.

Flying rules differ by source and the strictest one governs. Dive Andaman's shore DSD page says wait at least 12 hours; their boat DSD page says avoid flights for 12-18 hours; their 'New Diving Rules in Andaman & Nicobar Islands 2026' page states diving is prohibited within 24 HOURS before flying in a pressurised aircraft. A Thursday dive against a Sunday 10:35 departure gives roughly 70 hours, so the crew is clear under all three. Barefoot Scuba's FAQ has a 'When can I fly after scuba diving?' question whose answer text is broken (it discusses ear equalisation instead), so they publish no usable rule.

Dive Andaman's cancellation terms are harsh if plans move: 30 days or more before, 100% refund; 7-29 days, only 50%; less than 7 days, NO refund; plus a 5% administrative charge on refunds. Booking a monsoon-season dive more than a week out therefore carries real financial risk if the weather or the ferry changes the plan.

DiveIndia no longer sells a one-day beginner dive at either island. Their shortest beginner option is the 2-day Intro to Scuba at Rs 14,000 per person, so it cannot serve a single Thursday. Do not budget DiveIndia as a same-day try-dive option.

Barefoot Scuba's site is unreliable in places: barefootscuba.com and www.barefootscuba.com fail to load entirely (use barefootscuba.in), several internal pages 404, and the pricing itself is published only as an image, not as text. Prices were read from that image and should be reconfirmed by phone.

Session start times are unpublished for Barefoot Scuba, DiveIndia and Dive Tribe. Only Dive Andaman (05:00 am - 2:30 pm window) and Turquoise Dream (three fixed morning slots) state anything concrete. For a plan that hinges on timing, phone or WhatsApp each shortlisted operator to confirm the actual latest start.

No booking, login, or personal data entry was performed. On Turquoise Dream the booking flow was advanced only as far as the date-and-time step to read the published slots, and stopped before the Profile step.
